intent: New dedicated independent SMALL four-view supplement derived from accepted R02 construction/style and current L09; no existing 3D/render input.

input_images.role: Independent concept derivation/style reference, not existing geometry or output screenshot

actual_review.front: Five distinct empty open-top/front-access compartments per row, two rows total; thick dividers and back walls expose interior depth. Tan deck edges join charcoal corner posts and petrol collars. All visible feet contact the floor. Narrow top frame tie is not a third storage deck.
actual_review.side: Two supported bin levels with tangible side-wall/deck depth, front and rear post/foot profiles and connected top frame. Lateral compartments/posts overlap normally in this axis view; it does not introduce a sixth bay or extra level.
actual_review.rear: Exactly five backed compartment panels/seams on each of two levels. Both deck/support bands and top rear tie connect to grounded end-post pairs; rear is complete rather than an omitted open backside.
actual_review.three_quarter: Five empty compartment mouths on each level are individually readable. Four corner-post locations, connected deck/frame joins, floor contact and broad low depth agree with front/side/rear. No floating bin, cargo carton or third deck.
actual_review.style: Current R02 actually viewed as derivation input. Matte petrol/charcoal/tan, thick cuboid walls/posts, small stepped bevels and neutral grey background match. R02 three-across sketch is intentionally superseded by current L09 five-by-two definition.
actual_review.dimension_limit: Art is not a calibrated engineering drawing. Exact outer2.40x1.55x1.00, usable.42x.35x.42, deck topY.25/1.00, post bounds and bay centres come from target JSON, not raster spacing. No fit/rating/stock acceptance from image.
